# FDG3030

> DO use PascalCasing, and separate namespace components with periods (e.g., `Microsoft.Office.PowerPoint`). If your brand employs nontraditional casing, you should follow the casing defined by your brand, even if it deviates from normal namespace casing.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.4 Names of Namespaces.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE1006
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

IDE1006 checks the first letter of each namespace part through the naming rule configured by FDGA052; brand casing must be suppressed.
